subject: Clarify: evidence delivery fee vs. monthly surcharge for HIPAA + KMS/HSM
messages:
From: Emma Keller <emma.keller@cedarpointhealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-11-30T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: Clarify: evidence delivery fee vs. monthly surcharge for HIPAA + KMS/HSM

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for the call yesterday — appreciate the walkthrough. Procurement and I are trying to reconcile two line items on the draft commercial term sheet: an "evidence delivery fee" (one-time) vs a recurring "HIPAA on-call surcharge" and how those interact with the KMS/HSM seat pricing and audit-log retention tiers. A few concrete questions so we can finalize the PO: 

- If we take the one-time evidence delivery fee, what does it cover exactly (attestations, artifact packaging, on-site review prep)?
- If instead we take the recurring surcharge, can we get a credit against the KMS seat annual fee in year 1?
- For audit logs, our legal needs 7 years of high-fidelity retention for a subpopulation of PII-related events; does that map to your "retention tier 3"? If so, what's the per-GB charge and any minimums?

We'd like to avoid a large upfront invoice if possible, but we also have budget cadence that prefers Opex (monthly/annual). Can you outline three packaging options (one-time-first-year amortized, annual surcharge, blended credit) with ballpark economics?

Attached is our internal risk note that lists what evidence we expect (SOC 2 artifacts + HSM attestation rubric).

Thanks,
Emma
Emma Keller
Director, IT Risk & Compliance
CedarPoint Health

Attachment: cedarpoint_risk_note.pdf (reference)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Emma Keller <emma.keller@cedarpointhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Clarify: evidence delivery fee vs. monthly surcharge for HIPAA + KMS/HSM

Hi Emma — thanks, this is very clear. Quick answers up front and then three packaging options below.

Short answers:
- Evidence delivery fee: typically covers collection and packaging of attestations (SOC2 report excerpts and control narratives), HSM attestation coordination (proof-of-keys/mfg certs), and a 2-3 hour technical walk-through for your compliance team. It does not include multi-day on-site audits — those are scoped separately.
- Recurring HIPAA on-call surcharge: an annual (or monthly) operational fee that covers elevated support, on-call access for incident response, and extended evidence preparation windows. We can offer a limited year-1 credit against a KMS seat fee if you commit to a 12-month Dedicated capacity or Reserved commitment.
- Audit log retention: yes — what you described maps to retention tier 3 (7 years). For that tier we price at $0.045/GB/month for immutable, high-fidelity storage with a 100GB/month minimum in the pricing sheet.

Three packaging options (ballpark economics, not final):
1) One-time evidence delivery fee (recommended if you want lean monthly ops): $35k one-time. KMS seats billed as standard; no credits applied. Best if you want a single upfront compliance package and light Opex.

2) Recurring surcharge + year-1 KMS credit (best for Opex-friendly customers): $1,250/month surcharge (or $15k/year) + KMS seat credit of $10k applied in year 1 if you sign a 12-month reserved commitment. Audit log tier 3 charged per above.

3) Blended amortized credit (middle ground): amortize the evidence delivery fee over 12 months as a negative line item; net effect ~ $2k/mo for months 1–12 plus reduced KMS seat of 20% in year 1. Requires simple legal addendum to the SOW.

Next steps: I can put a formal pricing worksheet together and loop in Ben to check the KMS/HSM seat math and Laura to confirm commercial terms. Do you have a preference by noon PT tomorrow?

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Sales, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
